headline: Van Gerwen has beaten Van Veen 10 times in 14 meetings
standfirst: Gerwyn Price meets Kevin Doets at 1:15pm and Michael van Gerwen faces Gian van Veen at 2:45pm, with £100,000 guaranteed to each winner.
body: The Grand Slam of Darts semi-finals offer an old head-to-head story and a newer one. Michael van Gerwen, ranked 11th in the world, has won 10 of his 14 meetings with Gian van Veen, the world No 3, and the pair meet at 2:45pm in a first-to-16 tie. The winner is guaranteed £100,000 and the loser takes home £60,000.

Van Gerwen won this event in 2017 and arrives off a 10-8 win over James Wade. Van Veen's previous best here is a quarter-final in 2024, and he has won 98 of 162 matches over the last year without a title. Van Gerwen's 12-month average is 96.22 against Van Veen's 95.28, and the Dutchman has four titles in that time.

The earlier tie, at 1:15pm, pairs Gerwyn Price with Kevin Doets. Price, ranked fourth, won this tournament in 2018 and leads Doets 5-2 across seven meetings. He needed a 16-15 win over Niko Springer to get here. Price averages 98.66 over 12 months, the highest of the four semi-finalists, and has four titles.

Doets is ranked 23rd and is making his first appearance at the event on record. His 12-month average is 96.53, almost two points below Price's, yet he beat Jermaine Wattimena 16-7 in the quarter-finals and has won 128 of 181 matches over the last year.
If the first tie is about whether Doets can keep his momentum against a former champion, the second is about whether Van Veen can turn a head-to-head record of four wins in 14 around.
